tokens.name: jhu-heritage-blue
tokens.usage: THE brand color (PMS 288 C). Lead every layout with it: headings, primary buttons, dark fields. White, Spirit Blue, Gold, Mint, Sand and Orange text all pass on it.

tokens.name: jhu-spirit-blue
tokens.usage: Primary companion (PMS 284 C) that lightens the tone: secondary fields, chart series, eyebrows on Heritage Blue. NOT accessible with white text; set Heritage Blue or Sable on it.

tokens.name: jhu-medium-blue
tokens.usage: Cool accent. Links and inline CTAs on white (passes AA), hover state of primary buttons, focus ring, Card eyebrows.

tokens.name: jhu-harbor-blue
tokens.usage: Cool accent. With white only for large text (24px+).

tokens.name: jhu-mint-green
tokens.usage: Cool accent. Text or marks on Heritage Blue; use sparingly.

tokens.name: jhu-homewood-green
tokens.usage: Cool accent and the success color. Passes on white.

tokens.name: jhu-lime-green
tokens.usage: Cool accent, sparingly; not for text on white.

tokens.name: jhu-lavender
tokens.usage: Cool accent, sparingly; not for text on white.

tokens.name: jhu-plum
tokens.usage: Cool accent. Passes with white and on Spirit Blue.

tokens.name: jhu-purple
tokens.usage: Cool accent. Passes with white at large sizes.

tokens.name: jhu-gold
tokens.usage: Warm accent and the brand's high-emphasis CTA (Gold button, 4px accent bars, gold rules under titles). Set Sable text on it; Gold text only on Heritage Blue.

tokens.name: jhu-orange
tokens.usage: Warm accent and the warning color. Text on Heritage Blue only.

tokens.name: jhu-dark-red
tokens.usage: Warm accent and the danger/error color. Passes on white.

tokens.name: jhu-sand
tokens.usage: Warm accent. Text on Heritage Blue.

tokens.name: jhu-white
tokens.usage: Page and card surface. Whitespace is a brand tool.

tokens.name: jhu-double-black
tokens.usage: Only for high-contrast needs. Prefer Sable.

tokens.name: jhu-sable
tokens.usage: The brand black (PMS Black 4 C): body text, Toast and Tooltip fills. Grays are tints of Sable, never pure gray.

tokens.name: jhu-gray-80
tokens.usage: Tint of Sable; muted text on white.

tokens.name: jhu-gray-60
tokens.usage: Tint of Sable; captions and metadata at 12px+ (large or non-essential text only).

tokens.name: jhu-gray-40
tokens.usage: Tint of Sable; disabled marks, unchecked control borders.

tokens.name: jhu-gray-20
tokens.usage: Tint of Sable; hairlines and card borders.

tokens.name: jhu-gray-10
tokens.usage: Tint of Sable; image placeholders, subtle dividers.

tokens.name: jhu-gray-05
tokens.usage: Tint of Sable; subtle section backgrounds and hover fills.

tokens.name: text-heading
tokens.usage: Headings on surface-page, surface-subtle and surface-card.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body copy on surface-page, surface-subtle and surface-card.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on surface-page and surface-subtle.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links on white surfaces; underlined, offset 2px.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover: darkens to Heritage Blue.

tokens.name: surface-dark
tokens.usage: Dark brand fields: hero bands, header, footer, title slides.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline on inputs and controls; solid, 3:1+ on white.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success state; always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning state bar and dot; not a text color on white.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and danger state; passes on white.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrows and labels in Oswald, set ALL CAPS (text-transform: uppercase), Medium Blue on white or Spirit Blue on Heritage Blue.

tokens.name: radius-none

tokens.name: radius-full
